'''Hilkka Inkeri Kenttämaa''' is a researcher in organic and bioorganic [[mass spectrometry]], and the Frank Brown Endowed Distinguished Professor of Chemistry at [[Purdue University]]. She is a pioneer in distonic radical cation research and laser-induced acoustic desorption.

== Early life and education ==
Kenttämaa had initially planned to study mathematics, instead of chemistry, despite both her parents being chemists.<ref name=":0" /> She studied at [[University of Helsinki|Helsinki University]], earning a BS in 1977, a MS in 1978, a Phil. Lic.in 1981, and a PhD in Organic Chemistry in 1986. She did post-doctoral research with [[R. Graham Cooks]] at Purdue University in 1986.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Purdue Chemistry: Kenttämaa Labs: Hilkka I. Kenttämaa |url=https://www.chem.purdue.edu/hilkka/hilkka.html |access-date=2022-06-07 |website=www.chem.purdue.edu}}</ref>

== Career ==

She began her career as a research scientist at Helsinki University, the [[Academy of Finland]], and as a visiting research scientist at Purdue University. She joined the faculty at Purdue University in 1989, and was promoted to Full Professor in 1999.<ref name="purdue.edu">{{Cite web |title=Purdue University: College of Science: Chemistry professor receives distinguished honors |url=https://www.purdue.edu/science/e-newsletters/winter2016/distinguished-professor.html |access-date=2022-06-07 |website=www.purdue.edu}}</ref> Her projects include using [[tandem mass spectrometry]] to study reaction mechanisms<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Feng |first1=Erlu |last2=Ma |first2=Xin |last3=Kenttämaa |first3=Hilkka I. |date=2021-06-08 |title=Characterization of Protonated Substituted Ureas by Using Diagnostic Gas-Phase Ion-Molecule Reactions Followed by Collision-Activated Dissociation in Tandem Mass Spectrometry Experiments |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.analchem.1c00326 |journal=Analytical Chemistry |language=en |volume=93 |issue=22 |pages=7851–7859 |doi=10.1021/acs.analchem.1c00326 |pmid=34028247 |s2cid=235168836 |issn=0003-2700|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Kumar |first1=Rashmi |last2=Kenttämaa |first2=Hilkka I. |date=2020-10-07 |title=Effects of Analyte Concentration on the Protonation Sites of 4-Aminobenzoic Acid upon Atmospheric Pressure Chemical Ionization As Revealed by Gas-Phase Ion–Molecule Reactions |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jasms.0c00285 |journal=Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry |language=en |volume=31 |issue=10 |pages=2210–2217 |doi=10.1021/jasms.0c00285 |pmid=32852952 |s2cid=221359886 |issn=1044-0305|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and fast pyrolysis process.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Yu |first1=Zaikuan |last2=Murria |first2=Priya |last3=Easton |first3=Mckay W. |last4=Degenstein |first4=John C. |last5=Zhu |first5=Hanyu |last6=Xu |first6=Lan |last7=Agrawal |first7=Rakesh |last8=Delgass |first8=W. Nicholas |last9=Ribeiro |first9=Fabio H. |last10=Kenttämaa |first10=Hilkka I. |date=2019-10-24 |title=Exploring the Reaction Mechanisms of Fast Pyrolysis of Xylan Model Compounds via Tandem Mass Spectrometry and Quantum Chemical Calculations |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.jpca.9b04438 |journal=The Journal of Physical Chemistry A |language=en |volume=123 |issue=42 |pages=9149–9157 |doi=10.1021/acs.jpca.9b04438 |pmid=31545607 |bibcode=2019JPCA..123.9149Y |s2cid=202748635 |issn=1089-5639|url-access=subscription }}</ref> She is a pioneer in distonic radical cation research<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Kiminkinen |first1=L. K. Marjatta |last2=Stirk |first2=Krista G. |last3=Kenttamaa |first3=Hilkka I. |date=1992 |title=A remarkably stable organic radical cation: the distonic isomer of the unstable radical cation of dimethyl propyl phosphate |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/ja00032a015 |journal=Journal of the American Chemical Society |language=en |volume=114 |issue=6 |pages=2027–2031 |doi=10.1021/ja00032a015 |issn=0002-7863|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and laser-induced acoustic desorption.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Jarrell |first1=Tiffany M. |last2=Owen |first2=Benjamin C. |last3=Riedeman |first3=James S. |last4=Prentice |first4=Boone M. |last5=Pulliam |first5=Chris J. |last6=Max |first6=Joann |last7=Kenttämaa |first7=Hilkka I. |date=2017-06-01 |title=Laser-Induced Acoustic Desorption/Electron Ionization of Amino Acids and Small Peptides |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1007/s13361-017-1684-1 |journal=Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry |language=en |volume=28 |issue=6 |pages=1091–1098 |doi=10.1007/s13361-017-1684-1 |pmid=28500583 |bibcode=2017JASMS..28.1091J |s2cid=41709530 |issn=1044-0305|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Ma |first1=Xin |last2=Zhang |first2=Yuyang |last3=Lei |first3=Hao-Ran |last4=Kenttämaa |first4=Hilkka I. |date=2019-05-01 |title=Laser-induced acoustic desorption |url=https://doi.org/10.1557/mrs.2019.105 |journal=MRS Bulletin |language=en |volume=44 |issue=5 |pages=372–381 |doi=10.1557/mrs.2019.105 |bibcode=2019MRSBu..44..372M |s2cid=164846809 |issn=1938-1425|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

She was elected as a member of the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters|Finish Academy of Science]] in 2004.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ulkomaiset jäsenet |url=https://acadsci.fi/jasenet/ulkomaiset-jasenet/ |access-date=2022-06-07 |website=Tiedeakatemia |language=fi}}</ref> She serves as a subject editor in basic mass spectrometry for [[Mass Spectrometry Reviews]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mass Spectrometry Reviews Editorial Board |url=https://analyticalsciencejournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/hub/journal/10982787/homepage/editorialboard.html |access-date=June 7, 2022 |website=Wiley Analytical Science Mass Spectrometry Reviews}}</ref>
